summary: Happen, Inc. filed an 8-K to report a name change from LendingClub Corporation to Happen, Inc., effective June 22, 2026, via a Certificate of Amendment to its Certificate of Incorporation. The board approved the name change without stockholder vote. The company also transferred its common stock listing from the NYSE to the Nasdaq Global Select Market, changing its ticker from LC to HAPN, while the CUSIP remains unchanged; its banking subsidiary renamed to Happen Bank, National Association. This is a routine corporate branding and exchange transfer event with no special situation deal terms or economic terms disclosed.
